propositions: Python 3.11 asyncio.wait_for can consume external cancellation when child future completes in same turn, causing worker to loop with pending cancellation while lifespan awaits indefinitely
TestClient teardown cancels the opcert worker; when job completion and cancellation collide on Python 3.11, cancellation is swallowed and worker does not terminate promptly
Replacing asyncio.wait_for with asyncio.timeout semantics around to_thread call preserves external cancellation and fixes the hang without changing queue, ACK, schema, or timeout behavior
Regression oracle test_worker_cancellation_survives_job_completion_race was RED on Python 3.11 before fix and GREEN after, confirming the cancellation-completion race defect and its repair
